verdict.rationale: The REST API is versioned in its path (api.rollbar.com/api/1/items), and Rollbar documents a .NET SDK versioning policy with yearly LTS major releases supported for 18 months. However, no deprecation or sunset policy is documented for the REST API itself, and the SDK lifecycle policy covers only one SDK, not the API. missing for 10: documented REST API deprecation/sunset policy, explicit API versioning and change policy, deprecation timelines beyond the .NET SDK, independent corroboration.
